reasons.plausibility: Enhancing order to reduce scattering and strengthen electron-phonon coupling is a known mechanism for superconductivity, making the core idea scientifically sound with only minor open questions.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison of as-cast versus annealed samples with well-defined structural and superconducting property measurements provides a straightforward falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a direct pathway to tuning superconductivity in high-entropy alloys and a clear experimental plan that can guide further research.
